monster: You’re not ready. You’ll only prove you can’t do it.
replies: I can learn while I do it.
Being new doesn’t mean I’m incapable.
I don’t need to be perfect to start.
I’m giving myself a real chance.

monster: You know you’re going to mess this up.
replies: I’m more capable than this fear says.

monster: You don’t have proof that you can do this.
replies: I don’t need proof before I begin.
I have done hard things before.
I can ask for help if I need it.

monster: I’m trying to stop you from getting hurt.
replies: I hear you, but I’m still willing to try.
I can be brave and unsure at once.
I’ll be kind to myself if it’s hard.
I don’t need to shrink to stay safe.

monster: Everyone will find out you’re a fraud.
replies: No one is perfect, and that’s okay.
I belong here, even when I feel unsure.

monster: You’re just not smart enough.
replies: I can learn what I don’t know.

monster: Someone else would do this better.
replies: Maybe, but I’m the one here.
I bring my own way of doing it.
I don’t need to be the best to be worthy.

monster: You only succeeded because of luck.
replies: I showed up and did the work.
Luck helps, but I’m part of it.
I can own what I’ve done.

monster: Remember when you failed last time?
replies: One failure isn’t my whole story.
I’m not who I was then.
I’m trying again, and that’s brave.

monster: What if people see you’re not good enough?
replies: I can be enough as I am.
I’m allowed to be seen as I am.
My worth isn’t up for a vote.

monster: Wait until you feel confident.
replies: I can act while feeling unsure.

monster: Who are you to try this?
replies: I’m someone who’s allowed to try.
I’m a person with something to offer.
I don’t need permission to begin.

monster: Being a beginner is embarrassing.
replies: Being new is how learning begins.

monster: If it’s not perfect, it’s worthless.
replies: I can make it better step by step.

monster: They’re just being nice. They don’t mean it.
replies: I can believe a kind word.

monster: Stay quiet. Don’t draw attention.
replies: My voice matters in the room.
I can speak, even if it shakes.
I’d rather be known than hidden.

monster: Why even try? It won’t work.
They’re so much better than you.
replies: I can learn from them without shrinking.
I’ll grow at my own pace.

monster: They’ll judge you harshly.
replies: Some may. Many will be kind.
I can handle a little judgment.
I’ll keep my own opinion of me.

monster: You’ll fail, and everyone will see.
replies: I can fail and rise again.

monster: You’re not qualified for this.
replies: I can learn the rest on the way.
I have more skills than I credit.

monster: They’re thinking you don’t belong.
replies: I’m here because I’m invited, or I invited myself.
I’m allowed to take my seat.

monster: You always do this wrong.
replies: I can be kind in my self-talk.
I’ll notice what I did well.

monster: What if you succeed and can’t keep it up?
replies: Success can be handled in steps.
I’ll support myself along the way.

monster: It’s nothing special. Anyone could do it.
replies: Even if so, I did it.

monster: Aim lower. It’s safer.
replies: I can aim true and adjust.

monster: Don’t ask for help. They’ll know you’re clueless.
Where’s your evidence you’re good at this?
replies: I can collect it by trying.
I don’t need to prove it before starting.
My track record is longer than I think.

monster: You’ve always been like this.
replies: I can write a new chapter.
I’m not stuck with old stories.
I’m changing, one step at a time.
The past isn’t the whole me.

monster: There’s no room for you here.
replies: I can make my own space.

monster: You need way more experience first.
replies: I know enough for a first step.

monster: Everyone will notice your mistake.
replies: I can own a mistake and move on.
I’ll fix it and keep going.

monster: This is going to go badly.
replies: It might go better than I fear.

monster: Don’t let them down.
replies: I can do my best and that’s enough.

monster: Your idea is probably stupid.
replies: Let me say it and see.

monster: If you try, they’ll see your weaknesses.
replies: Weakness is part of being human.

monster: You don’t measure up.
Good things don’t happen to people like you.
replies: Good things can happen to me.

monster: Better to stay small than get hurt.
replies: I can be careful and still brave.
I can protect my heart and still try.

monster: Think about everything wrong with you.
replies: I can also think about what’s right.
My flaws don’t cancel my strengths.
I’ll count what I’m proud of.

monster: Real experts don’t feel this way.
replies: Doubt is common at every level.

monster: You’re too old, too young, too late, too early.
replies: The right time is a story.
I can begin where I am.
There’s no perfect age for trying.

monster: Prove it. Prove you’re worth it.
replies: I don’t have to earn my worth.
I don’t need to prove it today.

monster: You are who you are. You’ll never change.
Don’t give your full effort. Then failure won’t hurt.
replies: Giving my best is worth the risk.

monster: Your success doesn’t count.
You have nothing to offer.
replies: I have gifts that are mine.
I can contribute in my own way.
I’m more than I give myself credit for.

monster: Why would this time be different?
replies: Because I’m trying a kinder way.

monster: Your last win was just a fluke.
replies: A fluke doesn’t last this long.

monster: A brave person wouldn’t feel this scared.
replies: Fear and courage can sit together.
